1.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
1.asv: And he spake a parable unto them to the end that they ought always to pray, and not to faint;

2.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
2.asv: saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, and regarded not man:

3.web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
3.asv: and there was a widow in that city; and she came oft unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

4.web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
4.asv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

5.web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
5.asv: yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest she wear me out by her continual coming.

6.web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
6.asv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unrighteous judge saith.

7.web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
7.asv: And shall not God avenge his elect, that cry to him day and night, and yet he is longsuffering over them?

8.web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
8.asv: I say unto you, that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

9.web: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
9.asv: And he spake also this parable unto certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and set all others at nought:

10.web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
10.asv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

11.web: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
11.asv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as the rest of men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

12.web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
12.asv: I fast twice in the week; I give tithes of all that I get.

13.web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
13.asv: But the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote his breast, saying, God, be thou merciful to me a sinner.

14.web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
14.asv: I say unto you, This man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; but he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

15.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
15.asv: And they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

16.web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
16.asv: But Jesus called them unto him, saying, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.

17.web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
17.asv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.

18.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
18.asv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

19.web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.
19.asv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, even God.

20.web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
20.asv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor thy father and mother.

21.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
21.asv: And he said, All these things have I observed from my youth up.

22.web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”
22.asv: And when Jesus heard it, he said unto him, One thing thou lackest yet: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

23.web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
23.asv: But when he heard these things, he became exceeding sorrowful; for he was very rich.

24.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!
24.asv: And Jesus seeing him said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

25.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.”
25.asv: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

26.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
26.asv: And they that heard it said, Then who can be saved?

27.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
27.asv: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

28.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”
28.asv: And Peter said, Lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.

29.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God’s sake,
29.asv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or wife, or brethren, or parents, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

30.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
30.asv: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.

31.web: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
31.asv: And he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets shall be accomplished unto the Son of man.

32.web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
32.asv: For he shall be delivered up unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon:

33.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
33.asv: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

34.web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
34.asv: And they understood none of these things; and this saying was hid from them, and they perceived not the things that were said.

35.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
35.asv: And it came to pass, as he drew nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

36.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
36.asv: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.

37.web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
37.asv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

38.web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
38.asv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

39.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
39.asv: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

40.web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
40.asv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

41.web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
41.asv: What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

42.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
42.asv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath made thee whole.

43.web: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
43.asv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
